input-field.name: enableDebugging
input-field.label: Enable debug logging
Debug-Protokollierung aktivieren
input-field.helpText: Writes debug, info and warning entries to var/log/kommandhub_demodata_*.log. Errors are always logged regardless of this setting. Can be scoped to a single sales channel.
Schreibt Debug-, Info- und Warnungseinträge nach var/log/kommandhub_demodata_*.log. Fehler werden unabhängig von dieser Einstellung immer protokolliert.

input-field.name: logLevels
input-field.label: Log levels
Protokollstufen
input-field.helpText: Restrict debug logging to specific PSR-3 levels. Leave empty to log every level once debug logging is enabled.
